question: Does the SEARCH-selected top-K Neural Thickets ensemble outperform the base model on the untouched official Perspective-Taking test?
relation_to_previous: The previous study rejected the stronger standalone-expert hypothesis (NO_GO_VISUAL_NEURAL_THICKET_PERSPECTIVE_N5000, recorded here as NO_GO_STANDALONE_PERSPECTIVE_EXPERT). This addendum evaluates the same N=5,000 SEARCH population under the original RandOpt top-K ensemble protocol. Nothing in the previous result is changed.
committee: Exactly the top 50 of the committed SEARCH200 ranking (search lock committed before any validation output): SEARCH correct count descending, then SHA256(visual-rank-v1:candidate_id). No validation, test or bias information selects members.
population: Unchanged existing all-parameter population (PERTURB_VISUAL=1, snapshot anchoring). This matches the RandOpt top-K selection/ensemble protocol, but not necessarily the released worker default VLM parameter mask (which skips visual.* parameters) or its add/subtract restoration.
evaluation: Each committee member on all 561 official Perspective-Taking TEST questions with the frozen prompt, decoding and official direct scorer. Members already evaluated on TEST by the completed study are reused after full audit; only missing members are generated, each fingerprint-checked against its SEARCH state before generation, with zero-perturbation and repeat controls per shard.
voting: Upstream randopt.py run_ensemble_evaluation semantics: for each question collect the extracted answers of the first K committee members in SEARCH rank order, drop invalid (empty) answers, take collections.Counter(answers).most_common(1)[0][0] (ties resolve to the answer first seen in rank order), compare to the gold letter; a question with no valid answer counts as incorrect.
primary_endpoint: K=50 majority-vote TEST accuracy minus base TEST accuracy (259/561 = 46.17%).
k_curve: K = 1, 5, 10, 25, 50 as prefixes of the SEARCH ranking; descriptive only; K is not chosen using TEST.
decision: GO_RANDOPT_PERSPECTIVE_ENSEMBLE if the K=50 ensemble TEST accuracy is strictly greater than base TEST accuracy; otherwise NO_GO_RANDOPT_PERSPECTIVE_ENSEMBLE. The paired bootstrap 95% CI and exact McNemar test are reported alongside and are not part of the rule. The standalone-expert conclusion is preserved as NO_GO_STANDALONE_PERSPECTIVE_EXPERT.
secondary: Individual TEST accuracies of all 50 members (best, mean, median, counts > base, >= +1/+3/+5 pp); sub-task accuracies and prediction marginals for base and each nested ensemble, reported descriptively (the 80% concentration rule is not a gate for the committee).

statistics.method: paired question percentile bootstrap on TEST561, PCG64 int64 indices, 2.5/97.5 linear percentiles; exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs

no_rerun: SEARCH and VALIDATION are not rerun; existing results are not overwritten.
